digest.text:
Texas Polls Tracker, Tuesday, November 17, 2026

Talarico 75% to win the Senate seat on a polling average of D+4.0. Hinojosa 39% for governor. Democrats 79% to control the U.S. Senate, 91% for the House, 9% for the Texas House.

WHAT MOVED
- Nothing crossed the alert thresholds since the last snapshot.

TEXAS STATEWIDE
- U.S. Senate: Talarico 75%. Average D+4.0 over 30 polls; latest Research Co. Nov 2 D+3.0.
- Governor: Hinojosa 39%. Average R+1.7 over 27 polls; latest Research Co. Nov 2 R+2.0.
- Lieutenant Governor: Goodwin 26%. Average R+4.0 over 3 polls; latest Texas Southern University Oct 25 R+4.0.
- Attorney General: Johnson 27%. Average R+3.8 over 3 polls; latest Texas Southern University Oct 25 R+4.0.
- Comptroller: Eckhardt 20%. Average R+5.3 over 3 polls; latest Texas Southern University Oct 25 R+6.0.
- Railroad Commissioner: Rosenthal 39%. Average R+1.7 over 3 polls; latest Texas Southern University Oct 25 R+1.0.
- Land Commissioner: Flores 26%. Average R+4.0 over 3 polls; latest Texas Public Opinion Research Oct 18 R+1.0.
- Agriculture Commissioner: Tucker 25%. Average R+4.2 over 3 polls; latest Texas Public Opinion Research Oct 18 R+2.0.

TEXAS LEGISLATURE
- Statewide environment R+3.0: legislative generic ballot R+2.4 over 4 polls, down-ballot statewide races R+3.8; a D+10.7 swing from Trump's 2024 margin.
- Texas House: 62 D today; model expects 67.4 D seats, 9% for a Democratic majority (76). Closest: HD-121 51% D, HD-108 47% D, HD-112 58% D, HD-94 42% D, HD-133 40% D.
- Texas Senate: 12 D today; model expects 11.8 D seats, 0% for a majority (16). Closest: SD-9 58% D (Likely D), SD-11 12% D (Lean R), SD-2 9% D (Lean R).

U.S. SENATE
- Control: 79% for Democrats. Expected 51.9 Democratic-caucus seats; 51 needed.
- Closest races: IA 50% D (average —, 0 polls); AK 60% D (average —, 0 polls); KS 60% D (average —, 0 polls); ME 60% D (average —, 0 polls); OH 60% D (average —, 0 polls); SC 40% D (average —, 0 polls); TX 60% D (average —, 0 polls); MI 75% D (average —, 0 polls); NE 25% D (average —, 0 polls).

U.S. HOUSE
- Control: 91% for Democrats (expected 236.7 seats, 218 needed). Generic ballot D+8.1 over 3 polls.
- Texas seats in play: TX-15 63% D (Tilt D, polls D+7.0); TX-23 37% D (Tilt R, polls Even); TX-34 77% D (Lean D, polls D+7.0); TX-35 50% D (Tossup, polls R+1.0).
